subject: Acme evaluation kickoff — scheduling & success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acme.com>, James Park <james.park@acme.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-18T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Acme evaluation kickoff — scheduling & success criteria

Thanks again for the call today — great to meet you both. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can get the evaluation kicked off smoothly: 

- Goal: run a 2-week evaluation of Redwood inference on Acme search&assist flows to measure latency, cost, and response quality against your sample prompts.
- Success criteria (draft): API latency < 200ms p95, relevance score >= 0.78 on your eval set, < 5% format/regression errors. Please adjust.
- Proposed kickoff: 30-45 minute technical kickoff to align trial plan, owners, and the prompt set / evaluations.

Available windows for kickoff next week (PDT):
- Tue 2027-06-22: 10:00-10:45, 15:00-15:45
- Wed 2027-06-23: 09:00-09:45

I've looped in Connor (solutions engineer) who will run the technical demo and help scope the trial environment. If you can confirm a time and share any initial prompt samples or constraints (rate limits, dedicated GPU requirement), I'll send a calendar invite and a short evaluation plan template.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0122

--
Attachment: eval_plan_template.xlsx (attached when we finalize)

Marissa — thanks for the recap and proposed windows. Tue 6/22 10:00 PDT works well for us.

A couple quick asks before the kickoff so we can come prepared:
- Can you share the evaluation plan template and a short list of what Connor will demo?
- We'll bring our sample prompt set (short list) but want to confirm whether we need a dedicated pool or if shared hosted endpoints are fine for a first pass. Our primary concern is consistent latency.

I'll attach our initial sample prompts to this thread once James pulls them. See you Tue.

Best,
Sarah Liu

Perfect — locking Tue 6/22 10:00 PDT for the kickoff. Connor will run a short demo (~15 min) covering:
- Redwood API basics & auth model
- Serving modes (hosted vs dedicated) and cost/latency tradeoffs
- How we instrument prompt/eval sets and measure regressions

I've attached the evaluation plan template (eval_plan_template.xlsx) and added a quick draft agenda below. Please upload any sample prompts or a small CSV of examples before EOD Monday so Connor can pre-load them into the sandbox.

Draft kickoff agenda (30-45 min):
1) Intros & objectives (5 min)
2) Demo: integration + runtime behavior (15 min)
3) Trial plan & roles (10 min)
4) Success criteria, prompt set review, next steps (10-15 min)

Quick ask on success criteria: can you confirm which metric (latency vs relevance) should be prioritized? We'll propose default thresholds but want alignment.

I created a shared folder for evaluation artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c

Thanks — I'll send the calendar invite in the next message.

Cheers,

Also, for success criteria: prioritizing relevance first, then latency — but we do want latency to remain consistent (p95 target as you suggested).

Thanks — appreciate the prompt turnaround and the sample prompts, James. A few quick clarifications before I send the calendar invite:

- Environment recommendation: for the first two-week pilot our hosted shared endpoints should be fine given the concurrency you described. If you see burst usage or need stricter isolation we can move you to a small dedicated pool mid-pilot. Connor will cover this in the demo.
- Success criteria: noted — prioritize relevance, with the latency p95 threshold as a secondary constraint.
- Pre-kickoff ask: please upload the sample_prompts.csv to the shared Drive folder and add a short column with desired relevance labels if available.

Next steps (I'll take these):
- Send calendar invite for Tue 2027-06-22 10:00 PDT (30-45 min) — ACTION: Marissa
- Connor to prepare demo with your sample prompts pre-loaded — ACTION: Connor
- Acme to upload prompt CSV + any scoring guidance to the Drive folder — ACTION: Sarah/James

I'll attach the evaluation plan now and the invite will follow. Looking forward to it.
